lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Hello, Commander.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I heard that you requested a communiqué with me?
Yes, I wanted to confirm something.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: It sounds like an urgent matter.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Very well,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I will enact my judgment with the utmost precision and solemnity.
No, nothing like that.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Are you speaking in code, perhaps?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Once I decipher it, I'll get back to you.
I'm not speaking in code.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Roger!
It's too late. Delta is convinced that I'm speaking to her in some kind of cipher.
I'm being perfectly straightforward.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Roger!
Have you been going to the gym lately?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: If I'm understanding correctly, this is a question to determine whether I've been to the gym recently?
... That's exactly what I said.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: If that's the case, then the answer is yes.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Even when I have a full schedule, I never neglect my physical training.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I must be battle-ready at all times.
The gym filed a complaint.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I take it that means

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: there was a complaint against me?
Yes. They want to ban you.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: May I know the reason?
That's what I wanted to ask you.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I honestly can't think of anything.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: All I did was install some sensors in the gym.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: There are some open spaces in that facility which are vulnerable to enemy attacks.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Once any of those sensors detect something moving at more than 12 miles per hour,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: they'll self-detonate.
Go and dismantle those sensors right now!
Go and apologize to the gym right away!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Are you asking me to expose the gym to danger?!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I was merely doing maintenance work on the facility. Why do I have to apologize?!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I don't understand any of this.
It's an Ark facility.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Yes, and?
As you know, Delta, the Ark is a relatively safe place.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I suppose you're right.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: The facility itself may be defenseless, but I neglected to note the fact it's inside the ironclad Ark.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'll go take down those sensors at once.
Please do.
